title: A day worth heading out for
brief: Fictional demonstration for two adults looking for an easy day of art, independent food and a short waterside walk in an illustrative UK town. Budget and travel details are examples only. Real plans must verify the exact date, opening hours, prices, tickets, weather and transport from current sources.
offer: Day preferences: art, independent food, short walkable legs, four stops at most and an indoor swap.
